name: Eco Express Merchant API Documentation

description.content: Provide your Bearer token in the format: `Bearer {token}`

description:
Creating API Account

  1. Contact your Account Manager who is an Eco Freight representative, or contact info@ecofreight.ae to request for Merchant API Account creation.

  2. Your Account Manager will provide you with test and live environment access details for API, including the host_name for each environment.

  3. Once you have the access details and host_name provided, you can follow the rest of the documentation and request examples to use the API.

  4. API key will be provided by the account manager

HTTP Request Errors

Error Value Error Message Code
Access Denied Does not have token or expired 401
Forbidden Does not have permission 403

actions.name: Create a New Booking
actions.description:
• To create a booking, please use the POST method.
  • Kindly refer to "Create a New Booking" for more details.
  • Ensure that all mandatory fields are provided in the body in JSON format.
    • For the Service Type, refer to 'Retrieve Service Type' below.
    • For the Product Type, refer to 'Retrieve Product Type' below.
    • For the Country , refer to 'Get Country' below.
    • For the State, refer to 'Get State' below.
    • For the City , refer to 'Get City' below.
    • For the Currency, refer to 'Get Currency' below.
  • Note - Ensure all the required fields are accurate and aligned with the required data for successful booking creation.
Name Required Type Description
account_No yes String Account number of the concerned booking
service_type yes String The Service type of the account. Example. "Next Day Delivery", "Return Service", "Express Delivery" Possible Values: NDD, RTS. Can be retrieved from the Service type API.
product_type yes String The Product type of the account. Example. "Document", "Non Document" Possible Values: PT1, PT2. Can be retrieved from the Prodcut type API.
cop no Double Cash on Pickup in AED.
cop_currency no String Currency of Cash on Pickup.
special_instruction no String Special instruction for the booking.
booking_date yes String The date for the booking in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.Possible Value: 2025-01-06.
vehicle_type yes String The type of vehicle required for delivery. Possible Values: bicycle,bike, car,truck.
weight yes Double The total weight of the shipment in kilograms. Example: "2" (for 2 kg).
total_shipments yes number The total number of shipments in the booking. Example: "2" (for two shipments).
description yes string A description of the shipment. Example: "Laptop".
shipper_details yes object Details about the shipper.
company_name yes string Name of the company shipping the goods.
name yes string Name of the shipper.
address yes string Address of the shipper.
country yes string Country of the shipper. Possible values can be retrieved from the Countries API. Example: "UNITED ARAB EMIRATES" (Case sensitive).
state yes string State of the shipper. If UAE, enter Emirates name. Possible values can be retrieved from the State API. Example: "DXB" or "DUBAI" (Case sensitive).
city yes string City of the shipper - Area name. Possible values can be retrieved from the Cities API. Example: UMM "RAMOOL" (Case sensitive).
mobile_no_1 yes string Primary mobile number of the shipper. Example: "526928838".
mobile_no_2 no string Secondary mobile number of the shipper.
consignee_details yes object Details about the consignee (receiver of the shipment).
company_name yes string Name of the company receiving the goods.
name yes string Name of the consignee.
address yes string Address of the consignee.
country yes string Country of the consignee. Possible values can be retrieved from the Countries API. Example: "UNITED ARAB EMIRATES" (Case Sensitive).
state yes string State of the consignee. If UAE, enter Emirates name.Possible values can be retrieved from the State API. Example: "DUBAI" (Case Sensitive).
city yes string City of the consignee - Area name. Possible values can be retrieved from the Cities API. Example: "UMM RAMOOL" (Case sensitive).
mobile_no_1 yes string Primary mobile number of the consignee. Example: "526928838".
mobile_no_2 no string Secondary mobile number of the consignee.

actions.name: Create a New Shipment
actions.description:
• To create a shipment, please use the POST method.
  • Kindly refer to "Create a New Shipment" for more details.
  • Ensure that all mandatory fields are provided in the body in JSON format.
    • For the Service Type, refer to 'Retrieve Service Type' below.
    • For the Product Type, refer to 'Retrieve Product Type' below.
    • For the Country, refer to 'Get Country' below.
    • For the State, refer to 'Get State' below.
    • For the City, refer to 'Get City' below.
    • For the Currency, refer to 'Get Currency' below.
  • Note - Ensure all the required fields are accurate and aligned with the required data for successful shipment creation.
Name Required Type Description
account_No yes String Account number for the shipment.
service_type yes String Type of service for the shipment. Example : "Next Day Delivery", "Return Service". Possible values: NDD, RTS. Can be retrieved from the Service type API.
product_type yes String Type of product for the shipment. Example : "Document", "Non Document" Possible values: PT1, PT2. Can be retrieved from the Product type API.
reference_number no String Shipper reference number for the shipment. Leave empty if not applicable. Example: "ref1010".
cod no Number Cash on Delivery amount in AED.
cod_currency no String Currency for COD amount.
special_instruction no String Special instructions for the shipment.
invoice_value no Number Value of the invoice in AED.
invoice_currency no String Currency of the invoice value.
invoice_date yes String Date of the invoice in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".2025-01-13.
shipper_details yes Object Details of the shipper.
company_name yes String Name of the shipping company.
name yes String Name of the shipper.
address yes String Address of the shipper.
country yes String Country of the shipper. Possible values can be retrieved from the Countries API. Example: "UNITED ARAB EMIRATES".(Case sensitive).
state yes String State of the shipper. If UAE, enter Emirates name. Possible values can be retrieved from the State API. Example: "DXB" or "DUBAI" (Case sensitive).
city yes String City of the shipper - Area name. Possible values can be retrieved from the Cities API. Example: "UMM RAMOOL" (Case sensitive).
mobile_no_1 yes String Primary mobile number of the shipper. Example: "526928838"
mobile_no_2 no String Secondary mobile number of the shipper.
consignee_details yes Object Details of the consignee (receiver).
company_name yes String Name of the consignee company.
name yes String Name of the consignee.
address yes String Address of the consignee.
country yes String Country of the consignee. Possible values can be retrieved from the Countries API. Example: "UNITED ARAB EMIRATES" (Case Sensitive).
state yes String State of the consignee. If UAE, enter Emirates name.Possible values can be retrieved from the State API. Example: "DUBAI" (Case Sensitive).
city yes String City of the consignee - Area name. Possible values can be retrieved from the Cities API. Example: "UMM RAMOOL" (Case sensitive).
mobile_no_1 yes String Primary mobile number of the consignee.
mobile_no_2 no String Secondary mobile number of the consignee.
package_details yes Array Details about the package(s).
description yes String Description of the package.
quantity yes Integer Quantity of the item in the package.
weight yes Number Weight of the package in kilograms.
invoice_items no Array Details about the invoice items.
description yes String Description of the item in the invoice. Example: "Electronics"
hsCode no String HS Code of the item. Example: "8542"
origin no String Country of origin of the item. Example: "UNITED ARAB EMIRATES"
units yes Integer Quantity of units in the item.
unitPrice yes Number Price per unit.
unitOfMeasurement yes String Measurement unit of the item.

actions.name: Track a Booking
actions.description:
• To track a booking, please use the POST method.
  • Kindly refer to "Track a Booking" for more details.
  • Ensure that the body contains the following mandatory field in JSON format:
    • Booking Number: Provide the valid booking number to retrieve the booking details.

actions.name: Track a Shipment

• To track a shipment, please use the POST method.
  • Kindly refer to "Track a Shipment" for more details.
  • Ensure that the body contains the following mandatory field in JSON format:
    • AWB Number: Provide the valid AWB (Air Waybill) number to retrieve the shipment details.

actions.name: Retrieve Service Type
actions.description:
• To retrieve the service types, please use the POST method.

  • Kindly refer to "Retrieve Service Type" for more details.

  • Ensure that the body contains the following mandatory field in JSON format:

    • Portal Account Number: Provide your valid portal account number to fetch the available service types.

  • The retrieved service types can be used when creating an AWB or booking associated with your account.

  • Note: Ensure that the portal account number provided is valid and corresponds to your account to retrieve the correct service types.

actions.name: Retrieve Product Type
actions.description:
• To retrieve the product types, please use the POST method.

  • Kindly refer to "Retrieve Product Type" for more details.

  • Ensure that the body contains the following mandatory field in JSON format:

    • Portal Account Number: Provide your valid portal account number to fetch the available product types.

  • The retrieved product types can be used when creating an AWB or booking associated with your account.

  • Note: Ensure that the portal account number provided is valid and corresponds to your account to retrieve the correct product types.

actions.name: Get Countries
actions.description:
• To retrieve the list of available countries, please use the GET method.

  • Kindly refer to "Get Countries" for more details.

  • The response will contain the list of country details, including:

    • Country Name: The full name of the country.
    • Country Code: The corresponding ISO Alpha-3 country code.

  • When generating an AWB or making a booking, ensure to use the appropriate country name or code associated with your account.

  • Note: Ensure that the selected country details match the ones required for your account to avoid any discrepancies.

actions.name: Get States
actions.description:
• To retrieve the list of available states for a specific country, please use the POST method.

  • Kindly refer to "Get States" for more details.

  • Ensure to provide the Country Code in the request body to filter states for that country.

  • The response will include:

    • State Name: The full name of the state.
    • State Code: The corresponding state code.

  • When generating an AWB or making a booking, ensure to use the appropriate state name or code associated with the country in your account.

  • Note: Verify that the provided country code is valid and matches the one required for your account to retrieve accurate state details.

actions.name: Get Cities
actions.description:
• To retrieve the list of available cities for a specific state, please use the POST method.

  • Kindly refer to "Get Cities" for more details.

  • Ensure to provide the State Code in the request body to filter cities for that state.

  • The response will include:

    • City Name: The full name of the city.
    • City Code: The corresponding city code.

  • When generating an AWB or making a booking, ensure to use the appropriate city name or code associated with the state in your account.

  • Note: Verify that the provided state code is valid and matches the one required for your account to retrieve accurate city details.

actions.name: Get Currencies
actions.description:
• To retrieve the list of available currencies, please use the GET method.

  • Kindly refer to "Get Currencies" for more details.

  • The response will include:

    • Currency Name: The full name of the currency.
    • Currency Code: The corresponding currency code.

  • When generating an AWB or making a booking, ensure to use the appropriate currency code for your account.

  • Note: Always confirm that the selected currency is supported by your account for accurate transactions and data mapping.
